latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: complete observability and reliability engineering framework.

- Helps design and implement monitoring, structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, SLO/SLI frameworks, incident response, post-mortems, and system reliability audits.
- Includes a quick health check for assessing observability maturity.
- Provides practical guidance on structured logging—architecture, fields, log levels, scrubbing, language-specific setup, and storage options.
- Lists best practices and anti-patterns to improve log quality and operational visibility.
- Covers topics such as alert design, dashboard architecture, on-call operations, chaos engineering, and cost optimization.
